07 / About

Artist, producer, musician.

reyadreamer is a Jacksonville-based artist, producer and multi-instrumentalist making synth-driven pop, guitar music and surreal digital worlds.

The project grows from vintage keyboards, analog circuits, obsolete recording technology and the feeling of discovering a piece of software no one else remembers. Original music, production work and sound-design tools all live under the same name.

Korg DSS-1 · Yamaha DX7 · Korg DS-8 · Behringer Pro-800 · Poly D · Roland SDE-1000 · Tascam 424
